content:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding tiny-llama-3 shows tokenizer boundaries differ between HF and Redwood pretokenizer. Token counts +1 on a bunch of prompts, causing small eval regressions.
raj: Can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + token lists)?
maria: Quick one below — weird behavior around ZWJ and leading NBSP. Ran HF tokenizer vs redwood CLI: 
```
# HF
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('tiny-llama-3'); print(t.tokenize('Hello\u200dworld'))"
# Redwood pretokenizer CLI
redwood-tokenize --model tiny-llama-3 --text "Hello\u200dworld"
```
maria: HF output: ["Hello", "\u200dworld"]
redwood output: ["Hello\u200d", "world"]
raj: oof. That will shift token alignment for span evaluations. Is this before chat template wrapping or after?
maria: Pre-chatfmt — happens at the pretokenization stage. Also saw different handling for leading \u00A0 (NBSP) and BOM (\uFEFF). Byte-fallback seems to trigger for some codepoint sequences and produces sentinel bytes during quant eval, which changes top logits.
oliver: Do we have the tokenizer config.json for the converted model? Might be a normalizer/pre_tokenizer mismatch.
maria: Snippets from the converted config.json I dumped: 
```
"normalizer": {"type": "nfd"},
"pre_tokenizer": {"type": "byte_fallback", "enabled": true}
```
kai: Two immediate suspects: unicode normalization form (NFC/NFD/NFKC) and the byte_fallback pre-tokenizer order. Also pretokenizer grapheme splitting can differ. Our HF->Redwood conversion script needs to preserve the normalizer pipeline exactly or canonicalize inputs.
raj: Any measured impact on the eval suite?
maria: Quick run with quant+redwood-tokenizer default: PR@1 dropped from 94.6% -> 93.8% on our code-gen subset. chrF -0.7. I think boundary shifts explain most of it.
eval-bot: EVAL RUN 1765432140: tiny-llama-3 quant-q3: chrF -0.9, exact-match -0.8 vs baseline. See /evals/run_1765432140 (internal).
oliver: Short-term mitigation: normalize inputs to NFC before tokenization in the conversion wrapper, and turn off byte_fallback for known unicode ranges. Longer-term: make conversion emit explicit normalizer+pretokenizer blocks.
maria: I'll push a tiny patch to the converter to force nfkc and to keep byte_fallback as an opt-in. Will run full quant+eval tomorrow morning. Reproducer gist in the PR.
kai: I have a small test corpus (emoji+ZWJ sequences, NBSP, BOM, bidi) — will add those cases to the model onboarding evals. Ping me when PR is up.
maria: Thanks everyone. Adding @here :warning: — will post PR link and results once CI finishes.
